questions.stem: Given $\mathbf{a} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix}$ and $\mathbf{b} = \begin{pmatrix} -6 \\ 9 \end{pmatrix}$, which statement is true?
questions.explanation: $-3\mathbf{a} = -3\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -3 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} -6 \\ 9 \end{pmatrix} = \mathbf{b}$. So $\mathbf{b} = -3\mathbf{a}$, and the vectors are parallel (pointing in opposite directions).
